landing.about.heading: Built for Nepal. Starting in Chitwan.
landing.about.body: Sajilo Bazar exists to solve two problems every Nepali household and worker knows — finding help you can trust, and finding steady work. We're building it city by city, starting right here in Chitwan, where every worker is document-verified before they can take a job, pricing is shown upfront, and the whole job is tracked in the app from booking to payment.
